reviews.text: Clint was able to diagnose and correct an issue we had with our air system that another company wasn’t able to do. He was very professional and communicated in a way that made sense. I would highly recommend BNC Air!!!

I used BNC air earlier this year when my a/c wasn’t cooling like it should. Brandon was very quick to respond, came out the same day and fixed the problem with just a little bit of maintenance work.
I just had to call on them again because the house was heating properly. Brandon returned my call quickly, had me do some trouble shooting in order to save me s service call, and it worked! I’ll definitely use them for all of my HVAC needs in the future

Once again they have completely satisfied us.  We have owned our home for over 20 years. We used a different service provider years ago and our issue was not repaired after a few visits.  We called BNC Air and they fixed the problem the first time. We have depended on them ever since and they have never disappointed us.  This time it was our compressor in triple digit temps, but they were right there in the heat with us. We have had to call them out on weekends and in evenings and they are quick

I absolutely love this company.  BNC has done an amazing job with maintenance and repairs for our AC. Our home is over 20 years old and we still have our original unit thanks to these guys. They also tell it to me straight and they never try to add any extra unneeded things.  I can tell you some crazy stories of what some company’s have tried to talk me into to rack up my bill.  They are fast and reliable.  Thank you BNC!

We had the BNC team out to service our 20+ yr old AC system, and they were honest and ethical in their service to us, and truly did all they could to help get us back up and running! So when it was time to fully replace our system, it only made sense that we called BNC Air to do the replacement, and we could not be happier with our new system! For any/all HVAC needs, we HIGHLY recommend BNC Air!!!

Brandon and Clint are true professionals!  Good communication throughout the process of getting and installing our new AC.  They were quick and efficient when working, cleaned everything up when finished and very personable!  Highly recommend BNC Air!  Thank you!

We have used BNC AIR for the past 7+ years. They have expertly completed a couple of repairs on the A/C over the years, and have been our HVAC Preventive Maintenance Company for the twice yearly (Spring/Summer & Fall/Winter) tune-ups, which keeps our HVAC system running top notch! Clint and Brandon know their stuff, are always professional and extremely reasonable on their prices. If you need HVAC work, this is the company!

Guys are prompt, reliable, and efficient. Have used this company on numerous occasions, two of which were when I was out of town and the air went out. They were willing to meet my neighbor for inspection, call me with quote, and complete the repair before I got home. I appreciate their honesty and efficiency. Oh, and the bookkeeper is wonderful! Invoicing, payment, and receipt can all be done online! Great company!

I am giving them a 1 star because there was no option for a ZERO. We had them come out to fix a leak in our AC and they charged OVER $500! They charged us on the invoice over $35 for the valve part. Its a schrader valve! That can be bought online for $2 RETAIL. If you mark up the price of your parts so outrageously, then you are not an honest business person. Over $200 for labor that took less than an hour, and then of course the charge for the Freon (but considering the overpriced valve I have

BNC air to my rescue! My ac was out from the night before. I reached out to BNC and they immediately came to the rescue! They had it diagnosed within minutes! They knew exactly what to look for, and what needed to be done to repair it! They picked up the part, and had it repaired within the hour!!

They are the experts!!
I give BNC a solid five stars.  Clint is responsive, on time, professional, and honest.  Absolutely will use again and have no hesitation referring others to him.

Great custom service and i was truly impressed with the skill , this man really knows what He's doing. Prompt and diligent.
I'm very pleased with the high quality work done
